security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Retro pixel-art soccer with a full season and World Cup mode.
bundle.longDescription: Pixel Soccer League is a retro-styled soccer game featuring single-player and two-player matches, CPU exhibitions, a season campaign, and a full 48-team FIFA World Cup 2026 tournament mode.
